title: skeleton template variables
description: Values for templates/skeleton.md.j2 and templates/skeleton.html.j2. Field names match content/02-output-contract.xml; `description` on each property is the question put to the reviewer.

package_name.title: Package name
package_name.description: What is the package's exact registry name?

package_version.title: Package version
package_version.description: Which exact version was evaluated (1.3.0, never ^1.3.0)?

ecosystem.title: Ecosystem
ecosystem.description: Which package registry does it come from?

registry_repository_url.title: Registry repository URL
registry_repository_url.description: Where does the registry's repository field point?

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Who receives the Dependabot / Renovate / audit alert for this package, as role:handle?

checked_on.title: Checked on
checked_on.description: On which date was the advisory lookup run, as YYYY-MM-DD? Must be the day the record is written.

licence.title: Licence
licence.description: What SPDX identifier does the package metadata declare, cross-checked with the LICENSE file (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0, AGPL-3.0-only)?

transitive_count.title: Transitive count
transitive_count.description: How many packages does the lockfile diff add beyond the direct one, from a dry-run install?

maintainers.title: Maintainers
maintainers.description: How many publishing maintainers does the registry show?

last_release.title: Last release
last_release.description: When was the latest non-prerelease published, as YYYY-MM-DD?

in_house_reason.title: In-house reason
in_house_reason.description: Why is writing it ourselves (or using a package already in the lockfile) not the choice, in one line?

alternative_reason.title: Alternative reason
alternative_reason.description: Why was that alternative not chosen, in one line?

patch_window_critical.title: Patch window (critical)
patch_window_critical.description: Within how many days must a critical advisory be upgraded (e.g. 7d)?

patch_window_high.title: Patch window (high)
patch_window_high.description: Within how many days must a high advisory be upgraded (e.g. 30d)?

advisory_url.title: Advisory URL
advisory_url.description: What is the lookup URL for the exact package name and version?

lockfile.title: Lockfile
lockfile.description: Which committed lockfile records the exact version?

lockfile_commit_url.title: Lockfile commit URL
lockfile_commit_url.description: Which commit or PR updates the lockfile?

verdict.title: Verdict
verdict.description: What is the verdict — accept, accept-with-mitigation, reject or in-house?

alert_tool.title: Alert tool
alert_tool.description: Which tool sends the upgrade or advisory alert to the owner?
